summary: You pick one area focus: Archaeology or Culture and Society, whose theory course needs a B+ or better, or a self-designed focus whose theory course you move in once the minor advisor approves your plan of study. The audit also checks three 5-unit electives from the list, letter grades on every course, and the 20 units. You check the overall B by hand, since the text does not say whether it is per course or an average.

program.why: "Complete 20 units of ANTHRO subject code courses at the 300 level with an overall minimum letter grade of ‘B’, or higher." and "Three Elective Courses (Each elective course is 5 units and must be taken for a letter grade)"
